parts:
On Wednesday, September 30, 2015 at 4:34:28 PM UTC-4, F. Hu wrote:
it seems that the problem is "g++: internal compiler error: Killed (program cc1plus)". 
how can I solve this problem?

Have more RAM or utilize less RAM. If you g++ is 4.9 or later, you can follow the suggestion here

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started#configuration

If clang++ is available on the cluster, then you could instead do

cat("\nCXX=clang++", file = ~/.R/Makevars, append = TRUE)

If you are stuck with an older version of g++, you could try  

cat("\nCXXFLAGS+=-Os", file = ~/.R/Makevars, append = TRUE)

Ben
